name: Datavera dataset publisher
description: Pipeline: finds a public dataset it may reuse, downloads it, computes the analysis and charts, and publishes it to Datavera. Say a subject, paste a source page URL, or just say 'run'.

source_url.description: A source page to inspect directly

input_prompt: The user is asking a dataset-publishing robot to run. Extract: topic = the subject they want data about (a few words, empty if none); source_url = a web page URL they gave (empty if none); stop_after = 'draft' if they want to check it before it is submitted, 'validate' if they only want a test without creating anything, otherwise empty.
